data.summary: All figures (revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, EPS, R&D) and derived growth rates/margins match Apple's reported FY2025 and FY2024 results. Caveat: FY2024 net income was depressed by a ~$10.2B one-time EU state-aid tax charge, so the 19.5% net income growth overstates underlying earnings leverage (operating income grew ~8%). This is a framing issue, not a factual error.
